final: WITH m AS (SELECT f.orderslink AS orderslink, o.ordertune AS ordertune, f.rebtotal AS rebtotal, (f.rebrate - f.feerate) / NULLIF(f.feerate, 0) AS gap FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault), base AS (SELECT AVG(rebtotal) AS b FROM m) SELECT orderslink, ordertune, AVG(rebtotal) AS avg_rebate, AVG(gap) AS avg_relative_gap, AVG(rebtotal) - (SELECT b FROM base) AS excess_over_baseline FROM m GROUP BY orderslink, ordertune HAVING AVG(rebtotal) > (SELECT b FROM base) ORDER BY excess_over_baseline DESC LIMIT 10
